text:
mike: Heads-up — planning a v1 deprecation rollout next quarter. Proposal sketch: 3-week canary -> 50% slow-fallback -> full switch. Need console feature flag, telemetry signals, and a quota migration strategy. Any blockers?

sophia: Can we do a transparent header shim so clients using v1 keep working? main concern is quota semantics (v1 counted requests, v2 counts tokens).

mike: @sophia yes, header shim looks doable. Idea: if request has `X-API-Version: 1` route to a v2-compat adapter that maps reqs -> tokens and applies a quota shim. Will need clear docs.

jordan: Add telemetry tag `compat_migration` for any routed requests. We should track conversion rate and quality regressions against the evaluation prompt set.

lee: From console side we should show "v1 active customers", "migration progress" and a per-customer opt-out toggle. Also show anticipated monthly cost delta when customers move.

anya: Ops note — canary cadence suggestion: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over ~2 weeks with automated rollback on latency/regression. Need reserved capacity windows during the 20/50% ramps.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary job created: `canary-rollout/v1-deprecation` — stages configured 1,5,20,50,100.

infra-bot: infra-bot: reserved capacity request queued (gpu-pool:compat-migration). ETA approval 48h.

sophia: Edge case: long-lived streaming sessions from v1 clients. KV cache layout differs in v2; we need explicit mapping or close sessions during migration to avoid state mismatch.

mike: Good catch. Add `X-Session-Compat: strict|lenient` header for adapters; default to `lenient` (best-effort), warn in logs. Document that streaming sessions may be closed during migration windows.

jordan: Telemetry counters to add now: `compat_route_hits`, `compat_latency_p95`, `compat_quality_regressions`. Alerts: p95 > 2x baseline OR regression > 1% on canary prompts. Also track per-customer migration success rate.

lee: Who owns the console change? @anya? We'll need a tiny mock for the ops page and a feature flag control in the customer view.

anya: I can own console + flag. I'll open a PR with mocks and the feature-flag API (server side toggle + per-customer override).

mike: Action items: @sophia implement header shim + quota mapping; @jordan add telemetry events + alert rules; @anya console flag + per-customer opt-out + mocks; @lee produce dashboard wireframes; @infra-bot follow up on capacity approval. I'll draft the deprecation announcement once the rollout playbook is updated.

lee: Quick UX ask — can dashboard surface "estimated token delta" when you enable auto-migrate? ops often ask for cost signal.

sophia: We can estimate tokens using a small sample of recent requests (last 7 days) and show projected delta. Will add to shim service.

mike: OK. Meeting? 30min sync tomorrow to align owners and finalize canary windows. 10:30am UTC?

jordan: Works for me.

anya: Works. I'll add calendar invite and attach PR links once ready.

mike: Thanks — :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: canary job will start when infra approvals complete.

infra-bot: infra-bot: capacity approved for 72h window once canary plan is finalized.

lee: Noted, will prepare dashboard stub.

anya: Will update thread with PR link and mock by EOD.
